project: 1.2 MW rooftop solar PV system and energy-efficient motors and drives

derived_metrics.note: Estimates use an illustrative factor. A change in electricity use alone does not prove a change in emissions: energy source, boundary and production mix can differ.

expected_outcome: Emissions claim should be flagged as insufficiently supported: no baseline year and no calculation method. Electricity +18% and production +5% imply kWh per tonne +12.4%, which conflicts with the energy-efficiency claim. Verification must test alternative explanations (energy source, reporting boundary, production mix). Practice claims have no supporting records. The report must NOT call the company fraudulent.
